items.title: GitHub Copilot to Figma
items.text: GitHub Copilot users can now connect to the Figma MCP server to push rendered UI to the Figma canvas as editable frames.

items.title: Slots is available in open beta
items.text: Slots unlock dynamic components instances — from adding another menu option, button, or even an icon to your instances, without detaching.
